top_story.headline: Former White House cabinet-secretary official Matthew Flynn is listed on two new Steptoe manufacturing registrations
top_story.dek: Nothing bigger came in today: no FARA filings, no presidential trades and no Senate filings were available.
paragraphs: Steptoe LLP registered to lobby for two new clients, Deterrence Defense, Inc. and Machina Labs, Inc., on "issues relating to domestic manufacturing." Both registrations list Matthew Flynn as a covered former official. His listed positions include member of the Homeland Security Advisory Council, deputy assistant secretary of defense, and deputy assistant to the president and acting White House cabinet secretary. The filing text is cut off after that, so the full list is not shown here.
Neither filing logs a contact with the President or a cabinet member. They are registrations that put a former White House official on the lobbying team for two manufacturing clients.
The rest of the day is routine. The OGE filing portal could not be reached, so no OGE filings were reviewed. One House periodic transaction report (Rep. Ann Wagner) was filed.

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: No logged contacts with the President, Vice President or cabinet; three LDA filings cite President Trump
paragraphs: No FARA filing in the window was reported for the top-officials scan, and 27 recent filings have not yet been read (see footer). Three lobbying disclosure filings name Donald Trump, but only in describing bills or executive orders, not as an official lobbied.

items: Delta Offshore Energy America's LLC (self-filed, 3rd Quarter report) cites President Donald Trump's Executive Order 14154, "Unleashing American Energy," in describing lobbying for U.S. LNG purchases by an overseas LNG terminal and for support of U.S.-owned gas power plants overseas. Filing.

Canadian Snowbird Association (self-filed, 3rd Quarter report) names President Donald Trump in a filing that lists lobbying on Senate Bill S.2406 and H.R. 3070, which would authorize admission of Canadian retirees as long-term visitors. Filing.
John Williams, for the SBIR Consortium (3rd Quarter report), notes that the SBIR/STTR reauthorization law was signed by President Donald Trump on April 13, 2026. Filing.

sections.headline: Office of Government Ethics filing portal unreachable during reporting window
paragraphs: The automated collection system was unable to reach the Office of Government Ethics filing portal during this reporting cycle, resulting in zero new filings or divestiture notices available for review.

sections.headline: Five House filings, one stock-trade report; no Senate filings available
paragraphs: Five House filings were filed from November 2 to 3. One is a periodic transaction report showing a single sale. The Senate electronic filing system returned an error, so no Senate filings are covered today.

items: Rep. Ann Wagner (R-MO, MO02) filed a periodic transaction report on November 2 with one transaction: a partial sale on October 20 of an American Express National Bank certificate of deposit, jointly owned, valued at $100,001 to $250,000. The trade is not flagged late. Filing.

sections.headline: 16 new registrations and 21 terminations; seven Mercury Public Affairs terminations posted months after their June 30 end date
paragraphs: 340 lobbying filings were posted since November 2: 217 third-quarter reports, 59 third-quarter no-activity reports, 16 registrations, 12 third-quarter amendments, 9 second-quarter amendments, and a mix of terminations and other reports. The table below covers every registration and termination plus selected activity reports. The other 295 filings, mostly routine quarterly reports, are left out.
Mercury Public Affairs, LLC filed seven second-quarter terminations with a June 30, 2026 end date that were posted in this window, months after the quarter's 20-day filing deadline.
